description: The Hiring Signals contract for `GET /api/signals` and `GET /api/companies/{id}/signals`: every filter with its type, accepted values or range and what it matches, which filters the per-company endpoint takes, the focus-filter rule (which types a request with `functions`, `roles` or `job_regions` can return), paging and the two orders (`sort`), what a read costs, and how to poll for new signals in stored order (`sort=created_asc` with `created_after`) so each is read once. A signal is one event at one company, detected from its job postings. Read it before writing code that reads signals: each signal returned is billed at ten times the price of a job, and a signal read again is billed again. No API key and no network call: it answers from the filter contract this server ships with.
name: describe_signal_filters
title: Describe the Hiring Signals filters
